what.en: A volcano is a mountain with hot melted rock, called magma, deep inside. When it erupts, it can send out ash, rocks, and lava.
what.fil: Ang bulkan ay bundok na may mainit at tunaw na bato, na tinatawag na magma, sa loob nito. Kapag sumabog ito, naglalabas ito ng abo, bato, at lava.

signs.en: Rumbling sounds, more steam or smoke, small earthquakes, and plants drying up near the crater. PHIVOLCS raises Alert Levels.
signs.fil: Mga dagundong, mas maraming usok, maliliit na lindol, at natutuyong halaman malapit sa bunganga. Nagtataas ang PHIVOLCS ng Alert Level.

before.en: Know your evacuation route and evacuation center. Pack a Go Bag with face masks and goggles.
before.fil: Alamin ang daan ng paglikas at ang evacuation center. Maghanda ng Go Bag na may face mask at goggles.

during.en: Evacuate right away when told. If ash falls, stay indoors, close windows, and cover your nose and mouth with a mask or damp cloth.
during.fil: Lumikas agad kapag sinabihan. Kapag may bumabagsak na abo, manatili sa loob, isara ang bintana, at takpan ang ilong at bibig ng mask o basang tela.

after.en: Only go home when officials say it's safe. Let adults clean the ash while wearing masks.
after.fil: Umuwi lamang kapag sinabi ng mga opisyal na ligtas na. Hayaang ang nakatatanda ang maglinis ng abo habang naka-mask.

signoff.en: Remember: know your way out, and mask up when ash falls!
signoff.fil: Tandaan: alamin ang daan palabas, at mag-mask kapag may abo!
